acceptanceCriteria: All three comparison documents report the current ledger counts from the manifest.
A regression computes classification counts from the manifest and verifies the tri-language machine-readable snapshot markers.
The regression fails on stale or malformed documentation counts and passes on the corrected documents.
No governance claims or historical Work Item bytes are changed.
goal: Correct the documented classification counts and add a deterministic regression that derives expected counts from reference_file_inventory.json.
intent: Keep the tri-language reference comparison snapshot synchronized with the machine-readable inventory and prevent future count drift.
